lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Giovanna de Fátima | Lesson 8 -- Where, When and Who
lesson.grammar_point: question words (what, where, when, who, how) with present simple

listenings.text: Hi Giovanna, quick questions before the meeting. What time does the visit start? Where do we meet the team, at the gate or at the office? Who has the keys of the container? And how do they come from the airport? Send me a message with the answers. Thank you.

When I do not understand a word, I do not stay quiet. I ask. I say: Sorry, what does that mean? Or: How do you spell it? People are never angry. They answer, and I learn the word. My English is not perfect, but I always ask. That is my rule.

extra_audio.text: Giovanna reads the e-mail from London. She does not understand one word. She asks the meaning in the group chat. A colleague answers in two minutes. She writes the new word in her notebook.

paras: Hi Giovanna. Thank you for the report. It is very clear.
We have a visit next month. Two people from our office come to the site. They arrive on a Tuesday and they stay for three days.
Please book a hotel near the station for them. They do not drive, so this is important.
One more thing: the new machine arrives in October. Who is the engineer for the machine? Ask him to call me.
